title: pilosella longipila
intro: Pilosella longipila, commonly known as False Sowthistle, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family, native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella longipila include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit the growth of bacteria and fungi, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
